changes_from_1_0_0: Wrapper, documentation and one added reference record: the short replay is compared with the full signed Nov 9 H100 NVL short-replay record (recovered Nov 10, shipped unchanged as reference/nov09_h100_nvl_signed/short_replay/bundle_tiny_h100.json); demo summary file renamed to summary_<job>_<device>.json so the README bundle_*.json patterns match only the record; verify/compare/tamper-test reject non-record files with exit 2; inspect output, README, LICENSE header and this file. Engine files, fixtures, the 17 signed full-suite reference records and the public key are byte-identical to 1.0.0; build_sha256 and build_label are unchanged.

engine.name: Luxi Attention Transformer v2 exact inference engine, v27 final (frozen 2026-11-09)
engine.build_note: Compiled from the frozen source without code changes, except: docstrings and comments removed before compilation, and one `del` of a closure variable during weight loading replaced by rebinding it to None (a Cython limitation; frees the same object).

gpu.ptx: none (machine code only; other architectures are refused)

cpu.scope: short replay only; no CPU full-suite claim

model.architecture: Qwen2ForCausalLM, hidden 3584, 28 layers, 28/4 heads, vocab 152064, rope_theta 10000
model.quantization: publisher's original artifact (compressed-tensors int-quantized W8A8): int8 weights symmetric per output channel (static); int8 activations symmetric per token (dynamic); lm_head not quantized. Not created or modified by this package.

signing: each installation creates its own Ed25519 key on first use; the benchmark private key is not in this package
